lines.t: Yeah…
You been swingin’ at the sky, but it ain’t swingin’ back
You been bleedin’ for a throne that you’ll never have
Heart cold, but the fire still burnin’ within
I am the war that you never could win
You been fightin’ shadows, boxin’ with the wind
Load another clip just to aim at Him
Every time you run, I’m there again
I am the war that you never could win
War that you never could win
I see you with the mask on, braggin’ that you blast chrome
But when the flash gone, you alone with a cracked dome
You thought the crown was yours, so you built on sand
Now the tide rush in, pullin’ guns out your hand
You was flexin’ on the block, screamin’ “I don’t bow”
But your pride just a leash, got you chokin’ right now
You declare your own law, like you run this ground
But the breath in your lungs can get shut down
You wage war on the truth, but the truth don’t bend
Every bullet that you shoot comes back again
You can curse at the sky, you can carve your skin
But you can’t scar the One that you stand against
You a rebel with a death wish, metal on your necklace
Tryna outrun light, but the beam too restless
Every step that you take on the edge so thin
I am the war that you never could win
You been fightin’ shadows, boxin’ with the wind
Load another clip just to aim at Him
Every time you run, I’m there again
I am the war that you never could win
War that you never could win
You tried liquor, tried pills, tried layin’ in the dark
Tried inkin’ up the pain, put a razor to your heart
Tried money, tried fame, tryna play that part
But the void in your chest still tearin’ you apart
You say “no surrender,” tatted on your neck
But your demons do collections, and they come for debt
You got chains on your soul that your hands can’t break
Every lie that you told put a link in place
You roll dice with the grave, think you too hard to fall
But the ground don’t move when you start that brawl
You push back at the One that designed your breath
You just shadowbox God ‘til you swing at death
You hate mirrors ‘cause you see what you tryna outrun
All the damage that you did, everything you’ve done
You can fight all night, but the dawn still spin
I am the war that you never could win
Every scar you hide, every gun you grip
Every promise that you broke, every empty crib
Every siren in the night sound like your sin
You can’t drown that voice that’s speakin’ within
You been fightin’ shadows, boxin’ with the wind
Load another clip just to aim at Him
Every time you run, I’m there again
I am the war that you never could win
You can fight Me, curse Me, hate My name
But I still chase you through your shame
When your last lie breaks and the walls cave in
I’ll be the end of the war you could never win
Yeah, you think you bossed up, inked with the cross up
But your heart stay ice, all your love frosted up
You quote holy lines while you runnin’ dirty schemes
Double cup in your hand, counterfeitin’ your dreams
You in beef with the Light, tryna ride with the night
But the dark got a price, and it cash on sight
You roll deep, but the clique can’t step in front
When the last breath drop and your time get cut
I’m the line in the sand you can’t step across
I’m the weight on your chest when you count that cost
I’m the fire in your lungs when you choke on smoke
I’m the crack in the crown of the lies you spoke
I’m the hand that you slap when I pull you back
I’m the One that you blame when the mirrors crack
You can swing, you can shoot, you can drown in gin
But I am the war that you never could win
Never could win…
Every shot that you fire comes back again…
You war with the Love that could wash your sin…
See, I don’t need your respect, I don’t beg for your cheers
I was there in the dirt when you choked on fear
When your homie got hit and the blood ran out
When the judge read time and they walked you out
I was there in the cell when you stared at the wall
When you swore you would change but you missed My call
I was there in the night when you cursed My name
When you blamed Me for rage that you chose to flame
You been runnin’ from a love that would burn your chains
So you’d rather keep the pain than release that shame
You can lay your whole past in these hands you fear
But you clutch your gun tighter when I draw near
You don’t lose when you bow, you don’t die when you break
The old you goes down and the real you wake
When your last defense finally caves within…
That’s when the war that you never could win
Turns into peace you could never pretend
Turns into peace you could never pretend
All of your scars, I’ll carry them in
I’ll be the end of the war you could never win.
